teacher_initial.raw_label_audit: Existing all-query audit receipt re-bound to the identical teacher SHA; full pickle/raw replay requires --checkpoints.

teacher_extra.raw_label_audit: Existing all-query audit receipt re-bound to the identical teacher SHA; full pickle/raw replay requires --checkpoints.

excluded_debug_v1.reason: Add shared memory for deterministic acceptance-bound rejections; same preregistered seeds will be recollected
excluded_debug_v1.scope: All files retained. Completed-case work is an exact subtotal; interrupted/unflushed tail is not presented as zero work. No teacher.pkl was produced and this collection will not train models.

teacher.scope: Teacher depth-2 observed evidence is actor-only, not PPO rollout or horizon-16 critic target; interrupted v1 costs separate, unflushed tail unknown.

teacher_root_diagnostics.scope: Post hoc offline diagnosis of all 96 registered teacher roots; highest return among queried depth-2 suffixes only. No new queries, no PPO or horizon-16 oracle claims.

initial.scope: Masked supervised actor loss over queried evidence only; no unknown negative labels

continued.scope: Masked supervised actor loss over queried evidence only; no unknown negative labels

pipeline_receipt.scope: Numerical/interaction correctness only; not superiority evidence

prior_debug_pipeline_receipt.scope: Numerical/interaction correctness only; not superiority evidence

bc.scope: BC supervised updates and pipeline interactions are not included in formal PPO actions.

rule_selection.scope: All four registered ILS development-grid means independently recomputed; separate from 24 validation cases.

ppo_iterations.scope: Retained fresh on-policy interactions; collector boundaries do not terminate or finalize episodes. A separately recorded killed/uncommitted tail, if present, is not included.

completed_episodes.scope: All retained complete-episode scalar ledgers recomputed, not path replanning. complete_s includes optimizer/other-worker/validation waiting and is NOT deployment latency. Active workers are separate. At a restored episode boundary, physical cache deltas cover only post-load actions; preserved logical certification prefixes are separately checked against the retained interruption checkpoint under --checkpoints. Reset/load validation and any killed unlogged tail are outside these physical deltas, so this is not a total-process certification count.

interruption.scope: One killed uncommitted rollout may have executed 0..256 additional physical actions. Up to one rollout optimizer cycle (0..16 attempted updates) may also be lost before log flush. It contributes neither retained actor samples nor retained optimizer updates. Final 32768 is the retained on-policy count, not an exact total physical-call claim. Trainer elapsed time excludes interruption idle time and unlogged tail time. Resume creates and validates adapters outside episode cache deltas; these costs are not silently counted as zero.

saved_evaluations.scope: All saved final/stage JSON rows and evidence ledgers recomputed; this is not new path execution or timing. Only six explicitly identified cases are replayed with --replay.

reviewer_scope: Separate audit agent reviewed the existing teacher-module audit and recomputed saved evidence; inherited project context, not a zero-context external review.

interruption_checkpoint.scope: Checkpoint-to-log restore prefixes verified. Certificate hits/misses before an active prefix were not serialized; no physical breakdown is invented. Constructor reset/load preparation is outside restored cumulative reset counters.

teacher_initial.scope: Offline independent computation from all raw query/menu records. Recomputes highest suffix returns, prefix removal, terminal fees/corrections, evidence masks, ties and scene/route weights; not a rerun of teacher search or PPO rollout.

teacher_extra.scope: Offline independent computation from all raw query/menu records. Recomputes highest suffix returns, prefix removal, terminal fees/corrections, evidence masks, ties and scene/route weights; not a rerun of teacher search or PPO rollout.

checkpoints.scope: All checkpoint sources/finite tensors/parent identity and saved worker ledgers checked. Eight live episodes are kept unfinished; pending menu work is physical preparation, not yet debited reward. Metadata plus reviewed loader establishes shared BC parent; no unsaved initial PPO tensor snapshot is claimed.

actual_replay.scope: Six predeclared final fixed-work case/method runs physically reconstructed from saved inputs, policy observations/actions reproduced, all repairs and final validators rerun. Worker 0 checkpoint restored twice and sampled up to three real actions, stopping naturally; no other active worker finalized, no training counter modified. Audit time/cache queries are additional review costs, not deployment measurements.
